purpose: Edit bounded structured records in a semantic table with typed cell editors, row state, validation feedback, and keyboard traversal while leaving business rules to the consumer.
accessibility: Uses a native table with stable row and column context and labelled editors.
Arrow traversal, Escape cancel, and Ctrl or Meta plus Enter save keep keyboard editing bounded; row actions have explicit labels.
Cell errors and row status remain textual; native input and select semantics are preserved.
responsive: Keeps editable columns inside a bounded horizontal scroll owner on narrow Web layouts.
Uses shared control geometry and lets consumers switch to a table plus form or drawer workflow when inline editing is too dense.
motion: Uses shared duration and easing variables for focus and row-state transitions.

api.name: caption
api.description: Stable accessible name for the native table.

api.name: columns
api.description: Column definitions with optional typed editors and presentation metadata.

api.name: rows
api.description: Structured records rendered by the contract.

api.name: rowKey
api.description: Returns the stable key for each data row.

api.name: columnVisibility
api.description: Controls optional column visibility without changing row data.

api.name: density
api.description: Selects the shared table row density.

api.name: selectable
api.description: Adds canonical row and select-all controls.

api.name: onSelectionChange
api.description: Reports selection changes while leaving bulk action meaning to the consumer.

api.name: sort
api.description: Controlled sort state for sortable columns.

api.name: onSort
api.description: Reports a requested sort key without owning data ordering.

api.name: onCellChange
api.description: Receives an opaque editor value; validation, calculation, and persistence remain consumer-owned.

api.name: rowState
api.description: Presents consumer-supplied clean, dirty, saving, saved, or error state.

api.name: onRowSave
api.description: Reports an explicit row-save intent without persisting data in the grid.

api.name: onRowCancel
api.description: Reports an explicit row-cancel intent without restoring consumer data.

api.name: loading
api.description: Communicates pending work and prevents duplicate row interaction.

api.name: footer
api.description: Renders consumer-owned summary, pagination, or batch-action content below the table.
